Encryption key settings

Choose how the key that unlocks your vault is derived from your master password. All options are secure, but stronger ones protect better against guessing the master password, especially from a copy of the vault folder. The default settings suit most users.

We recommend %1$,d or more.

Values above the default improve security, but your vault takes longer to unlock, on this device and on the other devices that share the vault folder. Increase them in small steps, and try each change on all of your devices.

Your encryption key settings were changed on another device. Try again.
You will be logged out of this device and need to log in again with your new master password. The other devices that share the vault folder are logged out after their next sync.
Anyone who can read the vault folder can read the hint.

Changing your master password does not lock out someone who knows the old one: the vault folder, and any copy of it, can still hold the key of your vault encrypted with the old master password. If someone else may know your master password, export your vault, import it into a new account, and delete this account instead.
Your new master password cannot be the same as your current one.
Your master password hint cannot be the same as your master password.
Devices sharing the vault folder

Each device that shares the vault folder keeps its changes in a folder of its own there, named after the ID of the device. Retire a device that will not be used again, such as this app before its data was cleared: this device takes over what it kept, and its folder is deleted after 90 days. A device that is still used, but only to fill in passwords, may not have changed the vault for a long time either: tell the devices apart by their types and names.

Retire a device only if it will not be used again. This device takes over what it kept in the vault folder, and its folder there is deleted after 90 days. If it is still in use, it is no longer retired once it syncs, within a day. Devices with an earlier version of the app cannot open this vault until they are updated.
